# discord_role (Resource)

Manages a Discord guild role. Requires the bot to have the `MANAGE_ROLES` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_role" "moderator" {
  guild_id    = "123456789012345678"
  name        = "Moderator"
  color       = 3447003 # blurple
  hoist       = true
  mentionable = false

  permissions = [
    "VIEW_CHANNEL",
    "SEND_MESSAGES",
    "MANAGE_MESSAGES",
    "KICK_MEMBERS",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guild_id` (String) The snowflake ID of the guild the role belongs to. Changing this forces a new role.

### Optional

- `color` (Number) Integer RGB color of the role (0 means no color / inherit).
- `hoist` (Boolean) Whether the role is displayed separately in the member list.
- `mentionable` (Boolean) Whether the role can be mentioned by anyone.
- `name` (String) The role name. Defaults to Discord's `new role` when unset.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Set of Discord permission names granted to the role (e.g. `VIEW_CHANNEL`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The role snowflake ID.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the role is managed by an integration and cannot be edited.
- `position` (Number) The position of the role. Read-only; Discord assigns positions via a separate reorder endpoint not modeled here.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Roles are imported using the "guild_id:role_id" format.
terraform import discord_role.moderator 123456789012345678:987654321098765432
```
